newsitem.title: CHINA: Shangri-la Group to leave Shanghai Portman Hotel.
newsitem.headline: Shangri-la Group to leave Shanghai Portman Hotel.

text.p: Hotel operator Shangri-La Asia Ltd will end its management contract with Shanghai's Portman Hotel at the end of this year due to conflicts with two other Shangri-La hotels to be opened in the city, company officials said on Thursday.

The management contract for the Portman Hotel will be taken over by the Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, which is owned by Host Mariott Corp, with effect from January 1 1998, said a spokeswoman for Seacliff Group which owns the Shanghai Centre complex containing the Portman Hotel.
"The Shangri-La Group is opening two five-star properties in Shanghai within the next few years, and we felt the market could not support three Shangri-La's," said Seacliff's Susan Schulman.

A Shangri-La Hotel spokesman in Shanghai said the group planned to open a Shangri-La Hotel in the Pudong district of Shanghai to the east of the city centre in 1998, and a second hotel almost directly opposite the Portman in 2000.
